papers.title: SURFACE ROUGHNESS ANALYSIS OF SLM-PRODUCED TI-6AL-4V MILLING USING TAGUCHI DOE
papers.abstract: Selective Laser Melting (SLM) is an advanced additive manufacturing technique widely used to produce Ti-6Al-4V components with complex geometries and high material efficiency. However, SLM-produced Ti-6Al-4V commonly exhibits surface irregularities and a hardened microstructure, which necessitate post-processing by machining to achieve the required surface quality. Surface roughness is a critical parameter that influences the functional performance, fatigue life, and reliability of machined components, particularly in high-precision applications such as biomedical and aerospace engineering. This study investigates the surface roughness behaviour during milling of SLM-produced Ti-6Al-4V using a Taguchi-based Design of Experiments (DOE) approach. An L9 orthogonal array was employed to evaluate the effects of three machining parameters—spindle speed, feed rate, and depth of cut—each at three different levels. Surface roughness was assessed using the arithmetic mean roughness (Ra), measured with a contact-type surface profilometer. The experimental data were analysed using signal-to-noise (S/N) ratio analysis, supported by analysis of variance (ANOVA) to determine the contribution of each parameter. The results indicate that spindle speed is the most influential factor affecting surface roughness, contributing approximately 83.66% to the total variation. The optimal machining parameters for minimizing surface roughness were identified as a spindle speed of 7000 rpm, a depth of cut of 0.1 mm, and a feed rate of 1200 mm/min. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of the Taguchi DOE method and provide practical guidance for optimizing milling parameters in post-processing of SLM-produced Ti-6Al-4V components.

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文研究了SLM成形Ti-6Al-4V的铣削后处理工艺参数对表面粗糙度的影响，直接相关于后处理对疲劳性能的影响。
llm.why_not_core: The paper focuses on surface roughness optimization rather than directly measuring fatigue life or mechanical performance changes due to post-processing.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化SLM成形Ti-6Al-4V的铣削参数以提高表面质量。
summary_zh.method: 采用Taguchi L9正交实验设计，研究主轴转速、进给率和切削深度对表面粗糙度的影响。
summary_zh.result: 主轴转速是影响表面粗糙度的主要因素（贡献率83.66%），最优参数组合降低表面粗糙度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过接触式轮廓仪测量表面粗糙度并进行ANOVA分析验证。

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to optimize milling parameters for SLM-produced Ti-6Al-4V to achieve better surface quality, which is critical for mechanical performance.
summary_en.method: A Taguchi-based Design of Experiments (L9 orthogonal array) was used to evaluate the effects of spindle speed, feed rate, and depth of cut on surface roughness.
summary_en.result: Spindle speed was identified as the most influential factor (83.66% contribution), and optimal parameters were determined to minimize surface roughness.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation was performed by measuring arithmetic mean roughness (Ra) with a contact profilometer and analyzing data via S/N ratio and ANOVA.
